chapter: Depression gigs, Lil Armstrong, joining Chick Webb
title: Lil Armstrong's band at the Vendome Hotel in Buffalo
summary: McRae joined Lil Armstrong's band in Buffalo, where he met the Will Mastin Trio, then played the Harlem Theater in New York.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money

blocks.x: And Lil Armstrong was gigging, and Charlie Green said she wanted to work. So Charlie Green bought her that band -- Stuff Smith's band. Stuff got a small band. Jonah Jones and all the guys was in that band. (Inaudible) Stuff Smith's band.
And the winter of '36, I went up to join her, and that's when I met the Will Mastin Trio.

Will Mastin and Sammy Davis' father was doing a duet. There was two of them together. They was in the show. I went to join -- the Vendome Hotel -- that's where the showplace was at. It was a place in Buffalo.
Of Buffalo, yeah. And all the good names played there. (Inaudible). Big band. Lil has the band (inaudible) --
It was a good band, because I had played
S. & S. REPORTING COMPANY, INC. WOrth 2-2915 WOrth 2-2943
with the band before, so she wanted me to come up there. That's the band I showed you in that magazine.
And I worked with the band, and we came down, we played a theater -- the Harlem Theater, about March the same year. February or March of '36 Or so. (Inaudible).

Then we went back to Buffalo to finish out the gig up there. And then Charlie had booked us on some gigs all out through the West and all out through Kentucky, Ohio -- all up in the northern cherry --
What do you call that? The cherry country up there (inaudible)? (Inaudible) Minnesota, where the Green Bay Packers were from.
Yeah. Charlie had booked us all the way up there, all the way there.
